about_the_game:
The Leftovers KO!'s Digital Artbook

If you like the game, consider buying this artbook to support the developer even more :)

Featuring:

  • Concept Art – See how the characters evolved during the game's development

  • Spritesheets – Get insight into how many sprites it took to create detailed animation

  • Doodles – Check out random pictures that inspired or were created during the development process

  • Backstory – Gain a little more insight into the main protagonist’s personality and context for some of the things happening in the game

  • Random food facts – Some stats about pizza :)
